title: Evaluating Quality of Gaming Narratives Co-created with AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating narrative quality in games co-created with AI. While it includes 'Toxicity' (defined as the absence of rude, harmful, or offensive content) as one of its 23 Story Quality Dimensions, the study is aimed at creative narrative evaluation and player satisfaction rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or complex ethical/moral frameworks.
